d: AMAQ is an award-winning fitout/construction/contracting firm in KSA for the last 26 years. As our team continues to grow, we are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented Accountant to join our team. The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of accounting, financial reporting, VAT compliance, ZATCA Tax filing, audit preparation, and accounting software, along with solid Gulf/Saudi accounting experience.
DO NOT APPLY IF YOU CAN NOT JOIN WITHIN 15 DAYS.
Minimum 5 years of accounting experience in the Gulf region, preferably in Saudi Arabia.
Strong knowledge of IFRS and accounting principles.
Practical experience in VAT preparation and filing, preferably meeting Saudi ZATCA requirements.
Experience in preparing documents and schedules for external and internal audits.
Strong hands-on experience with Tally Prime; knowledge of other accounting/ERP systems is an advantage.
Good knowledge of financial reporting and preparation of financial statements.
Experience in month-end and year-end closing procedures.
Good understanding of accounts payable, accounts receivable, general ledger, bank reconciliation, and journal entries.
Experience in cash flow monitoring and financial analysis.
Ability to prepare management reports, financial schedules, and supporting documentation.
Knowledge of Saudi accounting, VAT, and statutory compliance requirements.
Experience reconciling customer, supplier, bank, and balance sheet accounts.
Ability to review invoices, expenses, payments, and supporting documents for accuracy and compliance.
Good understanding of accruals, prepayments, provisions, depreciation, and fixed asset accounting.
Strong Excel skills, including formulas, Pivot Tables, lookups, and financial data analysis.
Ability to coordinate effectively with auditors, banks, suppliers, customers, and internal departments.
Strong attention to detail, analytical skills, and ability to meet deadlines.
Ability to work independently and handle confidential financial information professionally.

The Senior Project Manager is responsible for leading the successful execution of projects while ensuring compliance with Hitachi Energy policies, contractual agreements, quality standards, health, safety and environmental requirements, financial objectives, and schedule commitments. The role drives project excellence through effective planning, execution, risk management, stakeholder engagement, and continuous process improvement to enhance project delivery effectiveness.
q: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Energy Systems, Project Management, or a related discipline.

10+ years of professional experience in project management, with at least 5 years leading complex Energy Systems, Power Transmission & Distribution, Grid Integration, Renewable Energy, Substation, or Automation projects.
Proven experience managing complex energy, power systems, transmission, distribution, grid automation, or renewable energy projects.
Strong knowledge of project management methodologies, contract management, risk management, and financial control.
Excellent leadership, communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent project management certification preferred.
Experience working in multicultural and matrix organizations is advantageous.
r: Lead and manage assigned project teams by establishing clear project execution strategies and delivery plans.
Define project guidelines, allocate responsibilities, and coordinate internal and external resources to achieve project objectives and milestones.
Motivate, monitor, and provide performance feedback to project team members.
Ensure effective collaboration and alignment across all project stakeholders.
Develop project execution plans in partnership with the Project Controls team, including: Scope management plansFinancial plans and budgetsProject schedulesRisk management plans
Ensure all planning activities are completed accurately and maintained throughout the project lifecycle.
Monitor schedule adherence and implement corrective actions when required.
Ensure projects are executed in accordance with Hitachi Energy policies, procedures, and best practices.
Monitor project performance, progress, and resource utilization to achieve project goals.
Manage project financials, including: Revenue recognitionInvoicing statusCost controlExpense managementCash flow forecasting
Identify, assess, quantify, and mitigate project risks while maximizing opportunities.
Capture and share project lessons learned to support organizational continuous improvement.
Drive successful project completion, formal customer acceptance, and contractual close-out.
Ensure consistent application of contract and claims management processes in accordance with contractual obligations and Hitachi Energy requirements.
Coordinate procurement activities with Supply Chain Management.
Support sourcing, supplier selection, negotiations, contract modifications, claims management, and project change requests.
Ensure timely availability of services, materials, and equipment required for project delivery.
Serve as the primary point of contact for customers throughout the project lifecycle.
Act as the escalation point for project-related issues and drive timely resolution.
Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, suppliers, partners, and internal stakeholders.
Ensure transparent and effective communication regarding project status, risks, opportunities, and performance.
Promote a culture of safety and compliance across all project activities.
Ensure adherence to Hitachi Energy Health, Safety and Environment policies and regulatory requirements.
Drive proactive risk identification and mitigation to maintain a safe working environment.
You will be responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
Living Hitachi Energy’s core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.
